canonicalPrompt.text:
Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Delyn Belan: 20-year-old man, 192 cm (very-tall), sturdy stocky construction with a broad frame and compact proportions, skin value band-5-medium-deep. Face: soft rectangular face; asymmetric brows and broad cheek planes; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; faint freckles. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: black, asymmetric-extreme, deliberate accent: dramatic contrasting side length. Wardrobe: draped-robe, specifically a draped robe whose belting and openings keep the body construction legible; a high soft collar and uneven layered hems; bounded palette indigo-sand. Visible personal details: one small nape tattoo; a repaired cuff with bright thread; a small throat necklace. Make repair, patina, customization, or a keepsake the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: visible mending treated as prideful craft. Color treatment: lets faded and repaired areas vary the palette. Pose cue: feet plant evenly while fingertips touch a small personal keepsake. Include a tiny cloth-wrapped notebook only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow. No affinity cue, elemental gem, floating, frame, printed star, number, UI, logo, watermark, text, extra person, duplicated anatomy, cropped extremity, or published-character resemblance. Fantasy hair colors are matte dye or pigment, never supernatural emission. Preserve plausible anatomy while allowing the declared body construction to be extreme.
